import numpy as np
from astropy.modeling import models as m
from astropy.modeling.separable import separability_matrix

# Test 1: Simple compound model (cm)
print("=" * 60)
print("Test 1: Simple compound model (Linear1D & Linear1D)")
print("=" * 60)
cm = m.Linear1D(10) & m.Linear1D(5)
print(f"n_inputs: {cm.n_inputs}, n_outputs: {cm.n_outputs}")
print("Separability matrix:")
print(separability_matrix(cm))
print()

# Test 2: Three models combined
print("=" * 60)
print("Test 2: Three models combined (Pix2Sky_TAN() & Linear1D & Linear1D)")
print("=" * 60)
cm2 = m.Pix2Sky_TAN() & m.Linear1D(10) & m.Linear1D(5)
print(f"n_inputs: {cm2.n_inputs}, n_outputs: {cm2.n_outputs}")
print("Separability matrix:")
print(separability_matrix(cm2))
print()

# Test 3: Nested compound model (the problematic case)
print("=" * 60)
print("Test 3: Nested compound model (Pix2Sky_TAN() & (Linear1D & Linear1D))")
print("=" * 60)
cm3 = m.Pix2Sky_TAN() & cm
print(f"n_inputs: {cm3.n_inputs}, n_outputs: {cm3.n_outputs}")
print("Separability matrix:")
print(separability_matrix(cm3))
print()

# Test 4: More complex nesting
print("=" * 60)
print("Test 4: More complex nesting")
print("=" * 60)
cm4 = (m.Pix2Sky_TAN() & m.Linear1D(10)) & m.Linear1D(5)
print(f"n_inputs: {cm4.n_inputs}, n_outputs: {cm4.n_outputs}")
print("Separability matrix:")
print(separability_matrix(cm4))
print()

# Test 5: Check the structure of cm3
print("=" * 60)
print("Test 5: Structure analysis of cm3")
print("=" * 60)
print(f"cm3.left: {cm3.left}")
print(f"cm3.left.n_inputs: {cm3.left.n_inputs}, cm3.left.n_outputs: {cm3.left.n_outputs}")
print(f"cm3.right: {cm3.right}")
print(f"cm3.right.n_inputs: {cm3.right.n_inputs}, cm3.right.n_outputs: {cm3.right.n_outputs}")
print(f"cm3.op: {cm3.op}")
print()

# Test 6: Check if right is a CompoundModel
print("=" * 60)
print("Test 6: Check if cm3.right is a CompoundModel")
print("=" * 60)
from astropy.modeling.core import CompoundModel
print(f"isinstance(cm3.right, CompoundModel): {isinstance(cm3.right, CompoundModel)}")
print(f"isinstance(cm3.left, CompoundModel): {isinstance(cm3.left, CompoundModel)}")
print()

# Test 7: Expected vs actual for nested model
print("=" * 60)
print("Test 7: Expected vs Actual for nested model")
print("=" * 60)
print("Expected separability matrix for Pix2Sky_TAN() & (Linear1D & Linear1D):")
print("  Pix2Sky_TAN has 2 inputs and 2 outputs (both inputs affect both outputs)")
print("  Linear1D(10) has 1 input and 1 output")
print("  Linear1D(5) has 1 input and 1 output")
print("  Total: 4 inputs, 4 outputs")
print("  Expected: diagonal blocks for separable parts")
expected = np.array([
    [True, True, False, False],
    [True, True, False, False],
    [False, False, True, False],
    [False, False, False, True]
])
print(expected)
print()
print("Actual separability matrix:")
print(separability_matrix(cm3))
print()

# Test 8: Check separability of submodels
print("=" * 60)
print("Test 8: Check separability of submodels")
print("=" * 60)
from astropy.modeling.separable import _separable
print("separability of cm3.left (Pix2Sky_TAN):")
print(_separable(cm3.left))
print()
print("separability of cm3.right (Linear1D & Linear1D):")
print(_separable(cm3.right))
print()
